_help: slide = right | bottom | alternate.  Each scene (use its exact title from scenes_en.txt, or its number) lists photos. Two kinds: {"commons": "File:Name.jpg"} is licence-checked on Wikimedia Commons and credited automatically; {"file": "photos/x.jpg", "credit": "Photo: Name"} is your own photo or one you have permission to use. Use calm photos of places, memorials and towns: no victims, no graphic scenes.
